**Academic System**

• **Degree**: Bachelor of Engineering (BE)
• **Duration**: 4 years (8 semesters)
• **Credits**: Minimum 160 credits
• **CGPA Scale**: 10.0
• **Evaluation**: Continuous assessment with internal tests, assignments, quizzes, and end-semester exams.

**Grading System**

| Grade | Marks Range | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| O | 90-100 | Outstanding |
| S | 80-89 | Excellent |
| A | 70-79 | Very Good |
| B | 60-69 | Good |
| C | 50-59 | Average |
| D | 40-49 | Pass |
| F | Below 40 | Fail |

Minimum 40% (D grade) is required to pass each subject.

**Academic Rules**

• **Passing**: Minimum 40% marks in each subject
• **CGPA**: Minimum 5.0 CGPA required for degree
• **Backlogs**: No more than 2 backlogs per semester allowed
• **Attendance**: Minimum 75% mandatory for exam eligibility
• **Grace**: Limited grace marks may be provided at exam committee discretion.

**Evaluation Pattern**

| Component | Weightage |
|-----------|----------|
| Internal Test 1 | 10% |
| Internal Test 2 | 10% |
| Assignments | 5% |
| Quiz | 5% |
| End Semester | 70% |

2 Internal Tests, 3 Assignments, 1 Quiz per semester.
Your CGPA is calculated as the weighted average of all semester GPAs multiplied by credits. Minimum 5.0 CGPA is required to pass. Ask me 'What is my CGPA?' to see your current CGPA from the database.
Your SGPA (Semester Grade Point Average) is the weighted average of your grades in a semester. Ask me 'Show my semester result' to see your SGPA for each semester.
You can have a maximum of 2 backlogs per semester. Backlogs must be cleared in subsequent attempts. Ask me 'How many backlogs do I have?' to see yours.
